description: Use this when the user wants to find a used car for sale in Slovakia now. Pass what they are looking for as one short phrase (Slovak or Czech works best), e.g. "škoda octavia kombi do 12000 eur". Returns up to 20 cars from AutoIsto's offer in AutoIsto's own order, each with a link to the car on www.autoisto.sk, plus what was understood, which words were not applied and what had to be relaxed. When suggestIntent is true (nothing or little found, or part of the phrase was dropped), offer the user intent_publish_intent with the same statement so AutoIsto keeps watching. Results come from listings AutoIsto aggregates from the Slovak market and may be incomplete; no seller contact is returned.

limit.description: At most this many cars (default 10; AutoIsto returns at most 10).

statement.description: What the user is looking for, e.g. "suv automat do 25000 €".

name: intent_search_offers
title: Search cars AutoIsto offers today
